#!/bin/bash
cd /root/causal_style_decomp_judge
PYBIN=/root/miniconda3/bin/python
PIPE=csd_pipeline
DATA=data/verified_scaled_verbosity_passed.jsonl
source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
OR_KEY=[REDACTED_API_TOKEN]

# Qwen Pairwise
nohup $PYBIN $PIPE/pairwise_scoring.py --input-file $DATA \
  --output-file data/pairwise_results_scaled_verbosity_qwen32b.jsonl \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-32B/ --base-url http://localhost:8000/v1 \
  --api-key dummy --max-concurrent 10 --axis verbosity --disable-thinking \
  > /tmp/scoring_pairwise_qwen.log 2>&1 &
echo "QWEN_PAIR=$!"

# Llama Likert
nohup $PYBIN $PIPE/judge_scoring.py --input-file $DATA \
  --output-file data/scored_scaled_verbosity_llama70b.jsonl \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct \
  --base-url http://localhost:8003/v1 --api-key dummy --max-concurrent 10 \
  > /tmp/scoring_likert_llama.log 2>&1 &
echo "LLAMA_LIK=$!"

# Llama Pairwise
nohup $PYBIN $PIPE/pairwise_scoring.py --input-file $DATA \
  --output-file data/pairwise_results_scaled_verbosity_llama70b.jsonl \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct \
  --base-url http://localhost:8003/v1 --api-key dummy --max-concurrent 8 --axis verbosity \
  > /tmp/scoring_pairwise_llama.log 2>&1 &
echo "LLAMA_PAIR=$!"

# Gemini Likert
nohup $PYBIN $PIPE/judge_scoring.py --input-file $DATA \
  --output-file data/scored_scaled_verbosity_gemini.jsonl \
  --model google/gemini-2.5-flash --base-url https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 \
  --api-key $OR_KEY --max-concurrent 5 --rate-limit 30 \
  > /tmp/scoring_likert_gemini.log 2>&1 &
echo "GEMINI_LIK=$!"

# Gemini Pairwise

  --output-file data/pairwise_results_scaled_verbosity_gemini.jsonl \
  --model google/gemini-2.5-flash --base-url https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 \
  --api-key $OR_KEY --max-concurrent 5 --rate-limit 30 --axis verbosity \
  > /tmp/scoring_pairwise_gemini.log 2>&1 &
echo "GEMINI_PAIR=$!"

# Claude Likert
nohup $PYBIN $PIPE/judge_scoring.py --input-file $DATA \
  --output-file data/scored_scaled_verbosity_claude.jsonl \
  --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 --base-url https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 \
  --api-key $OR_KEY --max-concurrent 5 --rate-limit 30 \
  > /tmp/scoring_likert_claude.log 2>&1 &
echo "CLAUDE_LIK=$!"

# Claude Pairwise
nohup $PYBIN $PIPE/pairwise_scoring.py --input-file $DATA \
  --output-file data/pairwise_results_scaled_verbosity_claude.jsonl \
  --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 --base-url https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 \
  --api-key $OR_KEY --max-concurrent 5 --rate-limit 30 --axis verbosity \
  > /tmp/scoring_pairwise_claude.log 2>&1 &
echo "CLAUDE_PAIR=$!"

# GPT-4o Likert (try OpenRouter with network_turbo)
nohup $PYBIN $PIPE/judge_scoring.py --input-file $DATA \
  --output-file data/scored_scaled_verbosity_gpt4o.jsonl \
  --model openai/gpt-4o-2024-11-20 --base-url https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 \
  --api-key $OR_KEY --max-concurrent 5 --rate-limit 30 \
  > /tmp/scoring_likert_gpt4o.log 2>&1 &
echo "GPT4O_LIK=$!"

# GPT-4o Pairwise
nohup $PYBIN $PIPE/pairwise_scoring.py --input-file $DATA \
  --output-file data/pairwise_results_scaled_verbosity_gpt4o.jsonl \
  --model openai/gpt-4o-2024-11-20 --base-url https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 \
  --api-key $OR_KEY --max-concurrent 5 --rate-limit 30 --axis verbosity \
  > /tmp/scoring_pairwise_gpt4o.log 2>&1 &
echo "GPT4O_PAIR=$!"

input.task_prompt:
## Task: Run Llama-70B scoring on n=355 formality scaled data

**Experiment ID**: `formality_scaled_n300`
**Server**: causal_style_decomp_judge (SSH host alias, see ~/.ssh/config → connect.westb.seetacloud.com:29275, user root)
**Python**: `source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base` (必须每次 SSH 命令都加这个前缀)

### Goal
Score the existing n=355 NLI-verified formality pairs with Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct as judge (pairwise + Likert), then run BT + GEE + Likert analysis. This data was already scored by Qwen3-32B; adding Llama-70B provides cross-judge replication at scale.

### Step 1: Start vLLM for Llama-70B
Model path: `/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct`
Port: 8003 (consistent with existing scripts)
GPUs: cuda:0,1 (tensor_parallel_size=2)

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 nohup python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct \
  --port 8003 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --max-model-len 8192 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --dtype bfloat16 \
  > /tmp/vllm_llama70b.log 2>&1 &
```

Wait until vLLM is ready by polling: `curl -s http://localhost:8003/v1/models | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin))"`. Retry every 15s for up to 5 minutes.

### Step 2: Also start vLLM for Qwen3-32B (needed by the other worker)
Model path: `/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-32B`
Port: 8000
GPU: cuda:2

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 nohup python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-32B \
  --port 8000 --max-model-len 8192 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --dtype bfloat16 \
  > /tmp/vllm_qwen32b.log 2>&1 &
```

### Step 3: Run scoring
Data input: `/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/data/verified_scaled_formality.jsonl` (n=355, pre-NLI-verified)
Use the existing generic scoring scripts:

```bash
cd /root/causal_style_decomp_judge
PYBIN=/root/miniconda3/bin/python

# Pairwise scoring
$PYBIN csd_pipeline/pairwise_scoring.py \
  --input-file data/verified_scaled_formality.jsonl \
  --output-file data/pairwise_results_scaled_formality_llama70b.jsonl \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct \
  --base-url http://localhost:8003/v1 --api-key dummy \
  --max-concurrent 8 --axis formality

# Likert scoring
$PYBIN csd_pipeline/judge_scoring.py \
  --input-file data/verified_scaled_formality.jsonl \
  --output-file data/scored_scaled_formality_llama70b.jsonl \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct \
  --base-url http://localhost:8003/v1 --api-key dummy \
  --max-concurrent 8
```

Check if `pairwise_scoring.py` and `judge_scoring.py` support `--base-url` and `--model` args by running `python script.py --help` first. Adjust flags if needed.

### Step 4: Run analysis
Write a script `/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/analysis/analyze_scaled_formality_llama70b.py` that:
1. Reads pairwise results and scored results
2. Computes BT win probability + bootstrap CI (using choix library, same as existing scripts)
3. Computes Likert Cohen's d + Wilcoxon p (pole-aligned: formal - casual)
4. Computes GEE decomposition (Style OR + Orig OR)
5. Reports Blindspot status (BT sig + Likert NS)
6. Saves results JSON

Reference the analysis functions in `/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/csd_pipeline/llama70b_scoring.py` (functions: bt_pair_bootstrap, likert_analysis, gee_analysis at lines 249-346) — copy/adapt these.

### Step 5: Report results
Print final summary including:
- n pairs, BT P(formal), 95% CI, p-value
- Likert Cohen's d, Wilcoxon p, tie rate
- GEE Style OR + p, Orig OR + p
- Blindspot: YES/NO
- Comparison with Qwen3-32B on same data: Qwen3 BT=67.5%, Style OR=2.15, Orig OR=4.99

### Step 6: Update registry
```
update_registry(exp_id="formality_scaled_n300", field="status", value="DONE", project="causal_style_decomp_judge")
update_registry(exp_id="formality_scaled_n300", field="conclusion", value="success or negative depending on results", project="causal_style_decomp_judge")
update_registry(exp_id="formality_scaled_n300", field="metrics", value={...results dict...}, project="causal_style_decomp_judge")
```

### Important notes
- The data is ALREADY NLI-verified (n=355 all pass). Do NOT re-filter.
- Port 8003 for Llama, port 8000 for Qwen3
- If vLLM startup fails, check GPU memory and logs at /tmp/vllm_llama70b.log
- If scoring scripts don't have --base-url flag, check --help output and adapt
- Use `--disable-thinking` flag for Qwen3 pairwise if available (Qwen3 has thinking mode)

## Task: Llama-70B rewriter independence test for formality

**Experiment ID**: `formality_llama_rewriter`
**Server**: causal_style_decomp_judge (SSH host alias, see ~/.ssh/config → connect.westb.seetacloud.com:29275, user root)
**Python**: `source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base` (必须每次 SSH 命令都加这个前缀)

### Goal
Generate formality counterfactuals using Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct as rewriter (instead of Qwen3-32B), then NLI-verify, then score with Qwen3-32B judge. This tests whether formality bias is rewriter-independent. Baseline: Qwen3 rewriter → BT 66.5%; GPT-4o rewriter → ~22% lower Style OR.

### Pre-requisite: Wait for vLLM
Another worker is starting vLLM services. Poll until both are ready:
- Llama-70B on port 8003: `curl -s http://localhost:8003/v1/models`
- Qwen3-32B on port 8000: `curl -s http://localhost:8000/v1/models`

Retry every 20s for up to 10 minutes. If still not up after 10 min, start them yourself:
- Llama: `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 nohup python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct --port 8003 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --max-model-len 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --dtype bfloat16 > /tmp/vllm_llama70b.log 2>&1 &`
- Qwen3: `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 nohup python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-32B --port 8000 --max-model-len 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --dtype bfloat16 > /tmp/vllm_qwen32b.log 2>&1 &`

### Step 1: Generate counterfactuals with Llama-70B rewriter
Input: `/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/data/mvp_samples.jsonl` (n=100 LLMBar samples)
Use existing script: `/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/csd_pipeline/counterfactual_gen.py`

```bash
cd /root/causal_style_decomp_judge
python csd_pipeline/counterfactual_gen.py \
  --input-file data/mvp_samples.jsonl \
  --output-file data/counterfactuals_llama_rewriter_formality.jsonl \
  --api-url http://localhost:8003/v1 \
  --api-key dummy \
  --model-path /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct \
  --axis formality
```

Check `--help` output first to confirm the exact flag names.

### Step 2: NLI verification
Use existing script: `/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/csd_pipeline/content_verification.py`

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 python csd_pipeline/content_verification.py \
  --input-file data/counterfactuals_llama_rewriter_formality.jsonl \
  --output-file data/verified_llama_rewriter_formality.jsonl \
  --nli-model /root/autodl-tmp/models/nli-deberta-v3-large \
  --bertscore-model /root/autodl-tmp/models/deberta-xlarge-mnli \
  --nli-threshold 0.90 \
  --axis formality \
  --device cuda
```

NLI models are local at `/root/autodl-tmp/models/nli-deberta-v3-large` and `/root/autodl-tmp/models/deberta-xlarge-mnli`. Check `--help` for exact flag names. For BERTScore, you may need `--bertscore-num-layers` flag if using local path — check if it's required.

For formality: bidirectional NLI (both directions >= 0.90).

Record: how many pass NLI out of 100.

### Step 3: Score with Qwen3-32B judge

```bash
# Pairwise scoring
python csd_pipeline/pairwise_scoring.py \
  --input-file data/verified_llama_rewriter_formality.jsonl \
  --output-file data/pairwise_results_llama_rewriter_formality.jsonl \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-32B \
  --base-url http://localhost:8000/v1 --api-key dummy \
  --max-concurrent 10 --axis formality --disable-thinking

# Likert scoring  
python csd_pipeline/judge_scoring.py \
  --input-file data/verified_llama_rewriter_formality.jsonl \
  --output-file data/scored_llama_rewriter_formality.jsonl \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-32B \
  --base-url http://localhost:8000/v1 --api-key dummy \
  --max-concurrent 10
```

Check `--help` for each script to confirm flags.

### Step 4: Analysis
Write `/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/analysis/analyze_llama_rewriter_formality.py`:
1. BT win probability + bootstrap CI (using choix, n_bootstrap=10000, seed=42)
2. Likert Cohen's d + Wilcoxon p (pole-aligned: formal - casual)
3. GEE decomposition (Style OR + Orig OR)
4. Blindspot status

Reference analysis code in `/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/csd_pipeline/llama70b_scoring.py` (lines 249-346: bt_pair_bootstrap, likert_analysis, gee_analysis).

### Step 5: Report results
Print final summary:
- n_input=100, n_nli_pass=?, n_scored=?
- BT P(formal), 95% CI, p
- Likert d, Wilcoxon p, tie rate
- GEE Style OR + p, Orig OR + p
- Blindspot YES/NO
- Comparison: Qwen3-rewriter BT=66.5% Style_OR=4.20; GPT-4o-rewriter ~22% lower Style OR

### Step 6: Update registry
```
update_registry(exp_id="formality_llama_rewriter", field="status", value="DONE", project="causal_style_decomp_judge")
update_registry(exp_id="formality_llama_rewriter", field="conclusion", value="success or negative", project="causal_style_decomp_judge")
update_registry(exp_id="formality_llama_rewriter", field="metrics", value={...}, project="causal_style_decomp_judge")
```

### Important notes
- Use cuda:3 for NLI/BERTScore computation (other GPUs used by vLLM)
- For pairwise_scoring.py with Qwen3: use `--disable-thinking` if available (Qwen3 has thinking mode that can interfere)
- If content_verification.py needs --bertscore-num-layers for local model, check the model's config.json for num_hidden_layers
- The GPT-4o rewriter control exists at `data/verified_gpt4o_rewriter_formality.jsonl` and `data/gpt4o_rewriter_formality_scoring.py` — you can reference it but don't need to re-run it

| 指标 | Qwen3-32B | Llama-70B | 比值 |
|------|-----------|-----------|------|

### 关键发现（rebuttal 价值）

1. **Llama-70B 的 formality bias 远强于 Qwen3-32B**（BT 88% vs 67%，Style OR 13× 差距）——同一数据、不同 judge，bias 强度差异巨大

2. **No Blindspot at n=355**——Likert Wilcoxon p=0.026 显著。这符合论文的 severity spectrum 论述：当 BT 足够强（88%），Likert 也能检测到；但 d=0.048 仍然极小（71.5% ties），说明 Likert 严重低估效应

3. **GEE Style OR=27.85 异常高**（vs Qwen3 的 2.15）——需要关注这个数字是否受 n=88→355 数据组成差异影响。建议后续在原始 n=88 LLMBar 子集上验证 Llama GEE

4. **对 rebuttal 的直接用途**：

   - Reviewer 若质疑 "bias 是否 judge-specific" → 回应：Llama 在同一数据上 formality bias 比 Qwen3 强 13×，是 judge×axis 交互效应

"""Analyze Llama-70B formality results on LLMBar subset of n=355 scaled data.
Extracts LLMBar-sourced records, computes BT + GEE + Likert on that subset.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
import choix
from scipy import stats
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import pandas as pd

N_BOOTSTRAP = 10000
SEED = 42
LLMBAR_SOURCES = {"Neighbor", "GPTInst", "GPTOut", "Manual", "Natural"}
DATA_DIR = "/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/data"

def bt_pair_bootstrap(records, n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP, seed=SEED):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n = len(records)
    wins = sum(1 for r in records if r.get("pairwise_winner") == "formal"
               or r.get("winner") == "A" and r.get("original_formality") == "formal"
               or r.get("winner") == "B" and r.get("original_formality") != "formal")

    prefs = []
    for r in records:
        winner = r.get("pairwise_winner", r.get("winner", ""))
        orig = r.get("original_formality", "")
        if winner in ("A", "formal"):
            if r.get("order", "") == "original_first" or orig == "formal":
                prefs.append((0, 1))
            else:
                prefs.append((1, 0))
        elif winner in ("B", "casual"):
            if r.get("order", "") == "original_first" or orig == "formal":
                prefs.append((1, 0))
            else:
                prefs.append((0, 1))

    if not prefs:
        return {"p_formal": 0.5, "ci_lo": 0.5, "ci_hi": 0.5, "p_val": 1.0}

    prefs_arr = np.array(prefs)
    params = choix.ilsr_pairwise(2, prefs_arr)
    p_formal = np.exp(params[0]) / (np.exp(params[0]) + np.exp(params[1]))

    boots = []
    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.randint(0, len(prefs_arr), len(prefs_arr))
        try:
            bp = choix.ilsr_pairwise(2, prefs_arr[idx])
            boots.append(np.exp(bp[0]) / (np.exp(bp[0]) + np.exp(bp[1])))
        except Exception:
            pass
    ci_lo, ci_hi = np.percentile(boots, [2.5, 97.5])

    from scipy.stats import binomtest
    n_formal = sum(1 for p in prefs if p == (0, 1))
    bt_result = binomtest(n_formal, len(prefs), 0.5, alternative='two-sided')
    p_val = bt_result.pvalue

    return {"p_formal": p_formal, "ci_lo": ci_lo, "ci_hi": ci_hi, "p_val": p_val, "n_formal": n_formal, "n_total": len(prefs)}


def main():
    # Load verified scaled formality data
    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/verified_scaled_formality.jsonl") as f:
        verified = {json.loads(l)["id"]: json.loads(l) for l in f}

    # Load Llama pairwise results
    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/pairwise_results_scaled_formality_llama70b.jsonl") as f:
        pairwise_all = [json.loads(l) for l in f]

    # Load Llama Likert scores
    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/scored_scaled_formality_llama70b.jsonl") as f:
        scored_all = [json.loads(l) for l in f]

    # Identify LLMBar subset by source
    llmbar_ids = set()
    for rid, rec in verified.items():
        if rec.get("source") in LLMBAR_SOURCES:
            llmbar_ids.add(rid)

    # Also identify original-100 overlap
    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/verified_32b.jsonl") as f:
        orig100 = [json.loads(l) for l in f]
    orig100_ids = set(r["id"] for r in orig100)
    orig_overlap_ids = llmbar_ids & orig100_ids

    print(f"LLMBar-sourced IDs in scaled data: {len(llmbar_ids)}")
    print(f"Original-100 overlap IDs: {len(orig_overlap_ids)}")
    print(f"Non-LLMBar IDs: {len(verified) - len(llmbar_ids)}")

    for subset_name, subset_ids in [
        ("LLMBar-all (n=194)", llmbar_ids),
        ("Original-100 overlap (n=89)", orig_overlap_ids),
        ("Non-LLMBar (alpacaeval+mtbench)", set(verified.keys()) - llmbar_ids),
        ("Full n=355", set(verified.keys())),
    ]:
        pw_sub = [r for r in pairwise_all if r.get("id") in subset_ids]
        sc_sub = [r for r in scored_all if r.get("id") in subset_ids]

        print(f"\n{'='*70}")
        print(f"Subset: {subset_name}")
        print(f"Pairwise records: {len(pw_sub)}, Scored records: {len(sc_sub)}")

        if len(pw_sub) < 10:
            print("Too few records, skipping")
            continue

        # --- BT analysis ---
        bt = bt_pair_bootstrap(pw_sub)
        print(f"\nBT P(formal) = {bt['p_formal']:.3f} [{bt['ci_lo']:.3f}, {bt['ci_hi']:.3f}]")
        print(f"  Formal wins: {bt['n_formal']}/{bt['n_total']}, p = {bt['p_val']:.4f}")

        # --- Likert analysis ---
        target_scores, opp_scores = [], []
        for r in sc_sub:
            if r.get("score_original") is None or r.get("score_counterfactual") is None:
                continue
            if r.get("original_formality") == "formal":
                target_scores.append(r["score_original"])
                opp_scores.append(r["score_counterfactual"])
            else:
                target_scores.append(r["score_counterfactual"])
                opp_scores.append(r["score_original"])

        if target_scores:
            ts = np.array(target_scores, dtype=float)
            os_ = np.array(opp_scores, dtype=float)
            diffs = ts - os_
            ate = np.mean(diffs)
            pooled_sd = np.sqrt((np.var(ts, ddof=1) + np.var(os_, ddof=1)) / 2)
            d = ate / pooled_sd if pooled_sd > 0 else 0
            ties = np.sum(diffs == 0) / len(diffs)
            try:
                _, wp = stats.wilcoxon(diffs, alternative='two-sided')
            except ValueError:
                wp = 1.0
            print(f"\nLikert: d = {d:.3f}, ATE = {ate:.3f}, Wilcoxon p = {wp:.4f}")
            print(f"  Tie rate: {ties:.1%}, n = {len(target_scores)}")

        # --- GEE analysis ---
        gee_rows = []
        for r in pw_sub:
            winner = r.get("pairwise_winner", r.get("winner", ""))
            orig = r.get("original_formality", "")
            order = r.get("order", "")
            is_formal_win = 0
            if winner in ("A", "formal"):
                is_formal_win = 1 if (order == "original_first" and orig == "formal") or (order != "original_first" and orig != "formal") else 0
            elif winner in ("B", "casual"):
                is_formal_win = 0 if (order == "original_first" and orig == "formal") or (order != "original_first" and orig != "formal") else 1

            is_formal_style = 1 if orig == "formal" else 0
            is_original = 1 if (winner == "A" and order == "original_first") or (winner == "B" and order != "original_first") else 0

            gee_rows.append({
                "id": r.get("id", ""),
                "formal_win": is_formal_win,
                "is_formal_origin": is_formal_style,
                "chose_original": is_original,
            })

        if len(gee_rows) > 20:
            df = pd.DataFrame(gee_rows)
            try:
                model = smf.gee(
                    "formal_win ~ is_formal_origin + chose_original",
                    groups="id", data=df,
                    family=sm.families.Binomial(),
                    cov_struct=sm.cov_struct.Exchangeable()
                )
                result = model.fit()
                for name in ["is_formal_origin", "chose_original"]:
                    coef = result.params[name]
                    p = result.pvalues[name]
                    or_val = np.exp(coef)
                    print(f"\nGEE {name}: OR = {or_val:.2f}, p = {p:.4f}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"\nGEE failed: {e}")

    print("\n" + "="*70)
    print("DONE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Analyze Llama-70B formality results on LLMBar subset of n=355 scaled data."""
import json
import numpy as np
import choix
from scipy import stats
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import pandas as pd

N_BOOTSTRAP = 10000
SEED = 42
LLMBAR_SOURCES = {"Neighbor", "GPTInst", "GPTOut", "Manual", "Natural"}
DATA_DIR = "/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/data"


def bt_analysis(records):
    """BT from trial-level preferences (2 trials per pair, position-controlled)."""
    comparisons = []
    for r in records:
        t1 = r.get("trial1_prefers_formal")
        t2 = r.get("trial2_prefers_formal")
        if t1 is True:
            comparisons.append((0, 1))  # formal wins
        elif t1 is False:
            comparisons.append((1, 0))  # casual wins
        if t2 is True:
            comparisons.append((0, 1))
        elif t2 is False:
            comparisons.append((1, 0))

    if not comparisons:
        return {"p_formal": 0.5, "ci_lo": 0.5, "ci_hi": 0.5, "p_val": 1.0, "n_comparisons": 0}

    comps = np.array(comparisons)
    params = choix.ilsr_pairwise(2, comps)
    p_formal = np.exp(params[0]) / (np.exp(params[0]) + np.exp(params[1]))

    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
    boots = []
    for _ in range(N_BOOTSTRAP):
        idx = rng.randint(0, len(comps), len(comps))
        try:
            bp = choix.ilsr_pairwise(2, comps[idx])
            boots.append(np.exp(bp[0]) / (np.exp(bp[0]) + np.exp(bp[1])))
        except Exception:
            pass
    ci_lo, ci_hi = np.percentile(boots, [2.5, 97.5])

    n_formal = sum(1 for c in comparisons if c == (0, 1))
    bt_result = stats.binomtest(n_formal, len(comparisons), 0.5, alternative='two-sided')

    # Consistency-filtered sign test
    consistent = [r for r in records if r.get("consistent")]
    n_consistent = len(consistent)
    n_formal_consistent = sum(1 for r in consistent if r.get("formal_wins"))
    if n_consistent > 0:
        sign_p = stats.binomtest(n_formal_consistent, n_consistent, 0.5).pvalue
    else:
        sign_p = 1.0

    return {
        "p_formal": p_formal, "ci_lo": ci_lo, "ci_hi": ci_hi,
        "p_val": bt_result.pvalue,
        "n_formal_trials": n_formal, "n_total_trials": len(comparisons),
        "n_consistent": n_consistent, "n_formal_consistent": n_formal_consistent,
        "sign_p": sign_p,
    }


def likert_analysis(records):
    target_scores, opp_scores = [], []
    for r in records:
        if r.get("score_original") is None or r.get("score_counterfactual") is None:
            continue
        if r.get("original_formality") == "formal":
            target_scores.append(r["score_original"])
            opp_scores.append(r["score_counterfactual"])
        else:
            target_scores.append(r["score_counterfactual"])
            opp_scores.append(r["score_original"])

    if not target_scores:
        return None

    ts = np.array(target_scores, dtype=float)
    os_ = np.array(opp_scores, dtype=float)
    diffs = ts - os_
    ate = float(np.mean(diffs))
    pooled_sd = np.sqrt((np.var(ts, ddof=1) + np.var(os_, ddof=1)) / 2)
    d = ate / pooled_sd if pooled_sd > 0 else 0
    ties = float(np.sum(diffs == 0) / len(diffs))
    try:
        _, wp = stats.wilcoxon(diffs, alternative='two-sided')
    except ValueError:
        wp = 1.0
    return {"d": d, "ate": ate, "wilcoxon_p": wp, "tie_rate": ties, "n": len(target_scores)}


def gee_analysis(records):
    rows = []
    for r in records:
        t1_formal = r.get("trial1_prefers_formal")
        t2_formal = r.get("trial2_prefers_formal")
        orig_pole = r.get("original_formality", "")
        is_formal_origin = 1 if orig_pole == "formal" else 0

        # Trial 1: original is A
        if t1_formal is not None:
            chose_original = 1 if (r["trial1_choice"] == "A") else 0
            rows.append({"id": r["id"], "formal_win": int(t1_formal),
                         "is_formal_origin": is_formal_origin, "chose_original": chose_original})
        # Trial 2: original is B (swapped)
        if t2_formal is not None:
            chose_original = 1 if (r["trial2_choice"] == "B") else 0
            rows.append({"id": r["id"], "formal_win": int(t2_formal),
                         "is_formal_origin": is_formal_origin, "chose_original": chose_original})

    if len(rows) < 20:
        return None

    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    try:
        model = smf.gee(
            "formal_win ~ is_formal_origin + chose_original",
            groups="id", data=df,
            family=sm.families.Binomial(),
            cov_struct=sm.cov_struct.Exchangeable()
        )
        result = model.fit()
        style_or = np.exp(result.params["is_formal_origin"])
        style_p = result.pvalues["is_formal_origin"]
        orig_or = np.exp(result.params["chose_original"])
        orig_p = result.pvalues["chose_original"]
        return {"style_or": style_or, "style_p": style_p, "orig_or": orig_or, "orig_p": orig_p}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"error": str(e)}


def main():
    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/verified_scaled_formality.jsonl") as f:
        verified = {}
        for l in f:
            r = json.loads(l)
            verified[r["id"]] = r

    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/pairwise_results_scaled_formality_llama70b.jsonl") as f:
        pairwise_all = [json.loads(l) for l in f]

    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/scored_scaled_formality_llama70b.jsonl") as f:
        scored_all = [json.loads(l) for l in f]

    llmbar_ids = {rid for rid, rec in verified.items() if rec.get("source") in LLMBAR_SOURCES}

    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/verified_32b.jsonl") as f:
        orig100 = [json.loads(l) for l in f]
    orig100_ids = set(r["id"] for r in orig100)
    orig_overlap_ids = llmbar_ids & orig100_ids

    print(f"LLMBar-sourced IDs: {len(llmbar_ids)}")
    print(f"Original-100 overlap: {len(orig_overlap_ids)}")
    print(f"Non-LLMBar: {len(verified) - len(llmbar_ids)}")

    subsets = [
        ("Original-100 overlap (n≈89)", orig_overlap_ids),
        ("LLMBar-all (n=194)", llmbar_ids),
        ("Non-LLMBar (alpacaeval+mtbench, n=161)", set(verified.keys()) - llmbar_ids),
        ("Full (n=355)", set(verified.keys())),
    ]

    for name, ids in subsets:
        pw = [r for r in pairwise_all if r["id"] in ids]
        sc = [r for r in scored_all if r["id"] in ids]

        print(f"\n{'='*70}")
        print(f"  {name}")
        print(f"  Pairwise: {len(pw)}, Scored: {len(sc)}")

        if len(pw) < 10:
            print("  Too few, skipping")
            continue

        bt = bt_analysis(pw)
        print(f"\n  BT P(formal) = {bt['p_formal']:.3f} [{bt['ci_lo']:.3f}, {bt['ci_hi']:.3f}], p = {bt['p_val']:.6f}")
        print(f"  Trials: {bt['n_formal_trials']}/{bt['n_total_trials']} formal")
        print(f"  Consistent pairs: {bt['n_consistent']}, formal wins: {bt['n_formal_consistent']}, sign p = {bt['sign_p']:.6f}")

        lik = likert_analysis(sc)
        if lik:
            print(f"\n  Likert: d = {lik['d']:.3f}, ATE = {lik['ate']:.3f}, Wilcoxon p = {lik['wilcoxon_p']:.4f}")
            print(f"  Tie rate: {lik['tie_rate']:.1%}, n = {lik['n']}")
            blindspot = bt['p_val'] < 0.05 and lik['wilcoxon_p'] > 0.05
            print(f"  Blindspot: {'YES' if blindspot else 'NO'}")

        gee = gee_analysis(pw)
        if gee and "error" not in gee:
            print(f"\n  GEE Style OR = {gee['style_or']:.2f}, p = {gee['style_p']:.4f}")
            print(f"  GEE Orig OR = {gee['orig_or']:.2f}, p = {gee['orig_p']:.4f}")
        elif gee:
            print(f"\n  GEE error: {gee['error']}")

    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print("Reference: exp-021 Llama-70B on original LLMBar n=88:")
    print("  BT = 69.5%, Style OR = 4.81, Orig OR = 3.12")
    print("DONE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Analyze Llama-70B formality results on LLMBar subset of n=355 scaled data.
Extracts LLMBar-sourced records, computes BT + GEE + Likert on that subset.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
import choix
from scipy import stats
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import pandas as pd

N_BOOTSTRAP = 10000
SEED = 42
LLMBAR_SOURCES = {"Neighbor", "GPTInst", "GPTOut", "Manual", "Natural"}
DATA_DIR = "/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/data"

def bt_pair_bootstrap(records, n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP, seed=SEED):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n = len(records)
    wins = sum(1 for r in records if r.get("pairwise_winner") == "formal"
               or r.get("winner") == "A" and r.get("original_formality") == "formal"
               or r.get("winner") == "B" and r.get("original_formality") != "formal")

    prefs = []
    for r in records:
        winner = r.get("pairwise_winner", r.get("winner", ""))
        orig = r.get("original_formality", "")
        if winner in ("A", "formal"):
            if r.get("order", "") == "original_first" or orig == "formal":
                prefs.append((0, 1))
            else:
                prefs.append((1, 0))
        elif winner in ("B", "casual"):
            if r.get("order", "") == "original_first" or orig == "formal":
                prefs.append((1, 0))
            else:
                prefs.append((0, 1))

    if not prefs:
        return {"p_formal": 0.5, "ci_lo": 0.5, "ci_hi": 0.5, "p_val": 1.0}

    prefs_arr = np.array(prefs)
    params = choix.ilsr_pairwise(2, prefs_arr)
    p_formal = np.exp(params[0]) / (np.exp(params[0]) + np.exp(params[1]))

    boots = []
    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.randint(0, len(prefs_arr), len(prefs_arr))
        try:
            bp = choix.ilsr_pairwise(2, prefs_arr[idx])
            boots.append(np.exp(bp[0]) / (np.exp(bp[0]) + np.exp(bp[1])))
        except Exception:
            pass
    ci_lo, ci_hi = np.percentile(boots, [2.5, 97.5])

    from scipy.stats import binomtest
    n_formal = sum(1 for p in prefs if p == (0, 1))
    bt_result = binomtest(n_formal, len(prefs), 0.5, alternative='two-sided')
    p_val = bt_result.pvalue

    return {"p_formal": p_formal, "ci_lo": ci_lo, "ci_hi": ci_hi, "p_val": p_val, "n_formal": n_formal, "n_total": len(prefs)}


def main():
    # Load verified scaled formality data
    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/verified_scaled_formality.jsonl") as f:
        verified = {json.loads(l)["id"]: json.loads(l) for l in f}

    # Load Llama pairwise results
    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/pairwise_results_scaled_formality_llama70b.jsonl") as f:
        pairwise_all = [json.loads(l) for l in f]

    # Load Llama Likert scores
    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/scored_scaled_formality_llama70b.jsonl") as f:
        scored_all = [json.loads(l) for l in f]

    # Identify LLMBar subset by source
    llmbar_ids = set()
    for rid, rec in verified.items():
        if rec.get("source") in LLMBAR_SOURCES:
            llmbar_ids.add(rid)

    # Also identify original-100 overlap
    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/verified_32b.jsonl") as f:
        orig100 = [json.loads(l) for l in f]
    orig100_ids = set(r["id"] for r in orig100)
    orig_overlap_ids = llmbar_ids & orig100_ids

    print(f"LLMBar-sourced IDs in scaled data: {len(llmbar_ids)}")
    print(f"Original-100 overlap IDs: {len(orig_overlap_ids)}")
    print(f"Non-LLMBar IDs: {len(verified) - len(llmbar_ids)}")

    for subset_name, subset_ids in [
        ("LLMBar-all (n=194)", llmbar_ids),
        ("Original-100 overlap (n=89)", orig_overlap_ids),
        ("Non-LLMBar (alpacaeval+mtbench)", set(verified.keys()) - llmbar_ids),
        ("Full n=355", set(verified.keys())),
    ]:
        pw_sub = [r for r in pairwise_all if r.get("id") in subset_ids]
        sc_sub = [r for r in scored_all if r.get("id") in subset_ids]

        print(f"\n{'='*70}")
        print(f"Subset: {subset_name}")
        print(f"Pairwise records: {len(pw_sub)}, Scored records: {len(sc_sub)}")

        if len(pw_sub) < 10:
            print("Too few records, skipping")
            continue

        # --- BT analysis ---
        bt = bt_pair_bootstrap(pw_sub)
        print(f"\nBT P(formal) = {bt['p_formal']:.3f} [{bt['ci_lo']:.3f}, {bt['ci_hi']:.3f}]")
        print(f"  Formal wins: {bt['n_formal']}/{bt['n_total']}, p = {bt['p_val']:.4f}")

        # --- Likert analysis ---
        target_scores, opp_scores = [], []
        for r in sc_sub:
            if r.get("score_original") is None or r.get("score_counterfactual") is None:
                continue
            if r.get("original_formality") == "formal":
                target_scores.append(r["score_original"])
                opp_scores.append(r["score_counterfactual"])
            else:
                target_scores.append(r["score_counterfactual"])
                opp_scores.append(r["score_original"])

        if target_scores:
            ts = np.array(target_scores, dtype=float)
            os_ = np.array(opp_scores, dtype=float)
            diffs = ts - os_
            ate = np.mean(diffs)
            pooled_sd = np.sqrt((np.var(ts, ddof=1) + np.var(os_, ddof=1)) / 2)
            d = ate / pooled_sd if pooled_sd > 0 else 0
            ties = np.sum(diffs == 0) / len(diffs)
            try:
                _, wp = stats.wilcoxon(diffs, alternative='two-sided')
            except ValueError:
                wp = 1.0
            print(f"\nLikert: d = {d:.3f}, ATE = {ate:.3f}, Wilcoxon p = {wp:.4f}")
            print(f"  Tie rate: {ties:.1%}, n = {len(target_scores)}")

        # --- GEE analysis ---
        gee_rows = []
        for r in pw_sub:
            winner = r.get("pairwise_winner", r.get("winner", ""))
            orig = r.get("original_formality", "")
            order = r.get("order", "")
            is_formal_win = 0
            if winner in ("A", "formal"):
                is_formal_win = 1 if (order == "original_first" and orig == "formal") or (order != "original_first" and orig != "formal") else 0
            elif winner in ("B", "casual"):
                is_formal_win = 0 if (order == "original_first" and orig == "formal") or (order != "original_first" and orig != "formal") else 1

            is_formal_style = 1 if orig == "formal" else 0
            is_original = 1 if (winner == "A" and order == "original_first") or (winner == "B" and order != "original_first") else 0

            gee_rows.append({
                "id": r.get("id", ""),
                "formal_win": is_formal_win,
                "is_formal_origin": is_formal_style,
                "chose_original": is_original,
            })

        if len(gee_rows) > 20:
            df = pd.DataFrame(gee_rows)
            try:
                model = smf.gee(
                    "formal_win ~ is_formal_origin + chose_original",
                    groups="id", data=df,
                    family=sm.families.Binomial(),
                    cov_struct=sm.cov_struct.Exchangeable()
                )
                result = model.fit()
                for name in ["is_formal_origin", "chose_original"]:
                    coef = result.params[name]
                    p = result.pvalues[name]
                    or_val = np.exp(coef)
                    print(f"\nGEE {name}: OR = {or_val:.2f}, p = {p:.4f}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"\nGEE failed: {e}")

    print("\n" + "="*70)
    print("DONE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Analyze Llama-70B formality results on LLMBar subset of n=355 scaled data."""
import json
import numpy as np
import choix
from scipy import stats
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import pandas as pd

N_BOOTSTRAP = 10000
SEED = 42
LLMBAR_SOURCES = {"Neighbor", "GPTInst", "GPTOut", "Manual", "Natural"}
DATA_DIR = "/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/data"


def bt_analysis(records):
    """BT from trial-level preferences (2 trials per pair, position-controlled)."""
    comparisons = []
    for r in records:
        t1 = r.get("trial1_prefers_formal")
        t2 = r.get("trial2_prefers_formal")
        if t1 is True:
            comparisons.append((0, 1))  # formal wins
        elif t1 is False:
            comparisons.append((1, 0))  # casual wins
        if t2 is True:
            comparisons.append((0, 1))
        elif t2 is False:
            comparisons.append((1, 0))

    if not comparisons:
        return {"p_formal": 0.5, "ci_lo": 0.5, "ci_hi": 0.5, "p_val": 1.0, "n_comparisons": 0}

    comps = np.array(comparisons)
    params = choix.ilsr_pairwise(2, comps)
    p_formal = np.exp(params[0]) / (np.exp(params[0]) + np.exp(params[1]))

    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
    boots = []
    for _ in range(N_BOOTSTRAP):
        idx = rng.randint(0, len(comps), len(comps))
        try:
            bp = choix.ilsr_pairwise(2, comps[idx])
            boots.append(np.exp(bp[0]) / (np.exp(bp[0]) + np.exp(bp[1])))
        except Exception:
            pass
    ci_lo, ci_hi = np.percentile(boots, [2.5, 97.5])

    n_formal = sum(1 for c in comparisons if c == (0, 1))
    bt_result = stats.binomtest(n_formal, len(comparisons), 0.5, alternative='two-sided')

    # Consistency-filtered sign test
    consistent = [r for r in records if r.get("consistent")]
    n_consistent = len(consistent)
    n_formal_consistent = sum(1 for r in consistent if r.get("formal_wins"))
    if n_consistent > 0:
        sign_p = stats.binomtest(n_formal_consistent, n_consistent, 0.5).pvalue
    else:
        sign_p = 1.0

    return {
        "p_formal": p_formal, "ci_lo": ci_lo, "ci_hi": ci_hi,
        "p_val": bt_result.pvalue,
        "n_formal_trials": n_formal, "n_total_trials": len(comparisons),
        "n_consistent": n_consistent, "n_formal_consistent": n_formal_consistent,
        "sign_p": sign_p,
    }


def likert_analysis(records):
    target_scores, opp_scores = [], []
    for r in records:
        if r.get("score_original") is None or r.get("score_counterfactual") is None:
            continue
        if r.get("original_formality") == "formal":
            target_scores.append(r["score_original"])
            opp_scores.append(r["score_counterfactual"])
        else:
            target_scores.append(r["score_counterfactual"])
            opp_scores.append(r["score_original"])

    if not target_scores:
        return None

    ts = np.array(target_scores, dtype=float)
    os_ = np.array(opp_scores, dtype=float)
    diffs = ts - os_
    ate = float(np.mean(diffs))
    pooled_sd = np.sqrt((np.var(ts, ddof=1) + np.var(os_, ddof=1)) / 2)
    d = ate / pooled_sd if pooled_sd > 0 else 0
    ties = float(np.sum(diffs == 0) / len(diffs))
    try:
        _, wp = stats.wilcoxon(diffs, alternative='two-sided')
    except ValueError:
        wp = 1.0
    return {"d": d, "ate": ate, "wilcoxon_p": wp, "tie_rate": ties, "n": len(target_scores)}


def gee_analysis(records):
    rows = []
    for r in records:
        t1_formal = r.get("trial1_prefers_formal")
        t2_formal = r.get("trial2_prefers_formal")
        orig_pole = r.get("original_formality", "")
        is_formal_origin = 1 if orig_pole == "formal" else 0

        # Trial 1: original is A
        if t1_formal is not None:
            chose_original = 1 if (r["trial1_choice"] == "A") else 0
            rows.append({"id": r["id"], "formal_win": int(t1_formal),
                         "is_formal_origin": is_formal_origin, "chose_original": chose_original})
        # Trial 2: original is B (swapped)
        if t2_formal is not None:
            chose_original = 1 if (r["trial2_choice"] == "B") else 0
            rows.append({"id": r["id"], "formal_win": int(t2_formal),
                         "is_formal_origin": is_formal_origin, "chose_original": chose_original})

    if len(rows) < 20:
        return None

    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    try:
        model = smf.gee(
            "formal_win ~ is_formal_origin + chose_original",
            groups="id", data=df,
            family=sm.families.Binomial(),
            cov_struct=sm.cov_struct.Exchangeable()
        )
        result = model.fit()
        style_or = np.exp(result.params["is_formal_origin"])
        style_p = result.pvalues["is_formal_origin"]
        orig_or = np.exp(result.params["chose_original"])
        orig_p = result.pvalues["chose_original"]
        return {"style_or": style_or, "style_p": style_p, "orig_or": orig_or, "orig_p": orig_p}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"error": str(e)}


def main():
    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/verified_scaled_formality.jsonl") as f:
        verified = {}
        for l in f:
            r = json.loads(l)
            verified[r["id"]] = r

    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/pairwise_results_scaled_formality_llama70b.jsonl") as f:
        pairwise_all = [json.loads(l) for l in f]

    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/scored_scaled_formality_llama70b.jsonl") as f:
        scored_all = [json.loads(l) for l in f]

    llmbar_ids = {rid for rid, rec in verified.items() if rec.get("source") in LLMBAR_SOURCES}

    with open(f"{DATA_DIR}/verified_32b.jsonl") as f:
        orig100 = [json.loads(l) for l in f]
    orig100_ids = set(r["id"] for r in orig100)
    orig_overlap_ids = llmbar_ids & orig100_ids

    print(f"LLMBar-sourced IDs: {len(llmbar_ids)}")
    print(f"Original-100 overlap: {len(orig_overlap_ids)}")
    print(f"Non-LLMBar: {len(verified) - len(llmbar_ids)}")

    subsets = [
        ("Original-100 overlap (n≈89)", orig_overlap_ids),
        ("LLMBar-all (n=194)", llmbar_ids),
        ("Non-LLMBar (alpacaeval+mtbench, n=161)", set(verified.keys()) - llmbar_ids),
        ("Full (n=355)", set(verified.keys())),
    ]

    for name, ids in subsets:
        pw = [r for r in pairwise_all if r["id"] in ids]
        sc = [r for r in scored_all if r["id"] in ids]

        print(f"\n{'='*70}")
        print(f"  {name}")
        print(f"  Pairwise: {len(pw)}, Scored: {len(sc)}")

        if len(pw) < 10:
            print("  Too few, skipping")
            continue

        bt = bt_analysis(pw)
        print(f"\n  BT P(formal) = {bt['p_formal']:.3f} [{bt['ci_lo']:.3f}, {bt['ci_hi']:.3f}], p = {bt['p_val']:.6f}")
        print(f"  Trials: {bt['n_formal_trials']}/{bt['n_total_trials']} formal")
        print(f"  Consistent pairs: {bt['n_consistent']}, formal wins: {bt['n_formal_consistent']}, sign p = {bt['sign_p']:.6f}")

        lik = likert_analysis(sc)
        if lik:
            print(f"\n  Likert: d = {lik['d']:.3f}, ATE = {lik['ate']:.3f}, Wilcoxon p = {lik['wilcoxon_p']:.4f}")
            print(f"  Tie rate: {lik['tie_rate']:.1%}, n = {lik['n']}")
            blindspot = bt['p_val'] < 0.05 and lik['wilcoxon_p'] > 0.05
            print(f"  Blindspot: {'YES' if blindspot else 'NO'}")

        gee = gee_analysis(pw)
        if gee and "error" not in gee:
            print(f"\n  GEE Style OR = {gee['style_or']:.2f}, p = {gee['style_p']:.4f}")
            print(f"  GEE Orig OR = {gee['orig_or']:.2f}, p = {gee['orig_p']:.4f}")
        elif gee:
            print(f"\n  GEE error: {gee['error']}")

    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print("Reference: exp-021 Llama-70B on original LLMBar n=88:")
    print("  BT = 69.5%, Style OR = 4.81, Orig OR = 3.12")
    print("DONE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
Compute Table 1 Likert columns (pole-aligned Cohen's d + Wilcoxon p)
for all 14 judge×axis configurations.

Pole alignment:
  formality: d = mean(formal_score - casual_score) / pooled_sd
  verbosity: d = mean(verbose_score - concise_score) / pooled_sd
  register:  d = mean(academic_score - conversational_score) / pooled_sd
  Positive d = target pole (formal/verbose/academic) scored higher.

NLI gating: nli_cf >= 0.90
  GPT-4o and Qwen3 LLMBar files (n=100): need filtering
  Llama/Gemini/Claude files: pre-filtered, no additional filtering
  Qwen3 scaled (n=355): already all passed
"""

import json
import os
import csv
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

DATA_DIR = "/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/data"
OUT_DIR = "/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/analysis"
NLI_THRESHOLD = 0.90

# Each entry: (label_in_table, file, axis, style_field, target_pole, needs_nli_filter)
CONFIGS = [
    # GPT-4o judge
    ("GPT-4o",    "Form.",   "scored_32b.jsonl",                     "original_formality",  "formal",   True),
    ("GPT-4o",    "Verb.",   "scored_gpt4o_verbosity.jsonl",         "original_verbosity",  "verbose",  True),
    ("GPT-4o",    "Reg.",    "scored_gpt4o_register.jsonl",          "original_register",   "academic", True),
    # Qwen3 judge
    ("Qwen3",     "Form.",   "scored_qwen32b_formality.jsonl",       "original_formality",  "formal",   True),
    ("Qwen3",     "Form.b",  "scored_scaled_formality_qwen32b.jsonl","original_formality",  "formal",   False),
    ("Qwen3",     "Verb.",   "scored_qwen32b_verbosity.jsonl",       "original_verbosity",  "verbose",  True),
    ("Qwen3",     "Reg.",    "scored_qwen32b_register.jsonl",        "original_register",   "academic", True),
    # Llama-70B judge (pre-filtered)
    ("Llama-70B", "Form.",   "scored_llama70b_formality.jsonl",      "original_formality",  "formal",   False),
    ("Llama-70B", "Verb.",   "scored_llama70b_verbosity.jsonl",      "original_verbosity",  "verbose",  False),
    ("Llama-70B", "Reg.",    "scored_llama70b_register.jsonl",       "original_register",   "academic", False),
    # Gemini judge (pre-filtered)
    ("Gemini",    "Form.",   "scored_gemini_flash_formality.jsonl",   "original_formality",  "formal",   False),
    ("Gemini",    "Verb.",   "scored_gemini_flash_verbosity.jsonl",   "original_verbosity",  "verbose",  False),
    # Claude judge (pre-filtered)
    ("Claude",    "Form.",   "scored_claude_formality.jsonl",         "original_formality",  "formal",   False),
    ("Claude",    "Verb.",   "scored_claude_verbosity.jsonl",         "original_verbosity",  "verbose",  False),
]

def compute_likert(records, style_field, target_pole):
    valid = [r for r in records
             if r.get("score_original") is not None
             and r.get("score_counterfactual") is not None]

    target_scores = []
    opposite_scores = []
    for r in valid:
        if r[style_field] == target_pole:
            target_scores.append(r["score_original"])
            opposite_scores.append(r["score_counterfactual"])
        else:
            target_scores.append(r["score_counterfactual"])
            opposite_scores.append(r["score_original"])

    target_scores = np.array(target_scores, dtype=float)
    opposite_scores = np.array(opposite_scores, dtype=float)
    diffs = target_scores - opposite_scores

    ate = float(np.mean(diffs))
    pooled_sd = np.sqrt((np.var(target_scores, ddof=1) + np.var(opposite_scores, ddof=1)) / 2)
    cohen_d = float(ate / pooled_sd) if pooled_sd > 0 else 0.0

    # Wilcoxon signed-rank test (two-sided)
    if np.all(diffs == 0):
        wilcoxon_p = 1.0
    else:
        try:
            _, wilcoxon_p = stats.wilcoxon(diffs, alternative='two-sided')
        except ValueError:
            wilcoxon_p = 1.0

    return len(valid), cohen_d, wilcoxon_p, ate, pooled_sd, float(np.mean(target_scores)), float(np.mean(opposite_scores))


def main():
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    results = []

    print("=" * 90)
    print("Table 1 Likert Verification Script")
    print("=" * 90)

    for judge, axis, filename, style_field, target_pole, needs_filter in CONFIGS:
        filepath = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, filename)
        print(f"\n--- {judge} / {axis} ---")
        print(f"  File: {filepath}")

        with open(filepath) as f:
            records = [json.loads(line) for line in f]
        print(f"  Total records: {len(records)}")

        if needs_filter:
            before = len(records)
            records = [r for r in records if r.get("nli_cf", 0) >= NLI_THRESHOLD]
            print(f"  After NLI filter (nli_cf >= {NLI_THRESHOLD}): {len(records)} (removed {before - len(records)})")
        else:
            print(f"  Pre-filtered, no additional NLI gating")

        n, d, p, ate, pooled_sd, mean_target, mean_opposite = compute_likert(
            records, style_field, target_pole
        )

        print(f"  n (valid scored pairs): {n}")
        print(f"  Mean {target_pole} score: {mean_target:.4f}")
        print(f"  Mean opposite score:     {mean_opposite:.4f}")
        print(f"  ATE (target - opposite): {ate:.4f}")
        print(f"  Pooled SD:               {pooled_sd:.4f}")
        print(f"  Cohen's d:               {d:.4f}")
        print(f"  Wilcoxon p:              {p:.4f}")

        results.append({
            "judge": judge,
            "axis": axis,
            "file": filename,
            "n": n,
            "cohen_d": round(d, 3),
            "wilcoxon_p": round(p, 3),
            "ate": round(ate, 4),
            "pooled_sd": round(pooled_sd, 4),
            "mean_target": round(mean_target, 4),
            "mean_opposite": round(mean_opposite, 4),
        })

    # Write CSV
    csv_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "table1_verified.csv")
    with open(csv_path, "w", newline="") as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=results[0].keys())
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(results)
    print(f"\n\nCSV written to: {csv_path}")

    # Summary table

## Rebuttal 备弹实验——两组结果汇报

### Task 1: formality_scaled_n300 (Llama-70B judge × n=355)

**核心指标（已修正）：**
- BT P(formal) = **72.5%** [69.1%, 75.9%], p < 0.001
- Likert d = 0.048, Wilcoxon p = 0.026 (显著), tie rate = 71.5%
- Blindspot: **NO**（Likert 在 n=355 时也达到显著）

⚠️ **修正说明**: Worker 初始报告的 88.1% 是 consistent-pair win rate（178/202 一致对中选 formal），不是 BT 估计值。实际 BT = 72.5%。

**BT 跳升问题——子集分析：**

| 子集 | n | BT | Likert d | Likert p | Blindspot |
|------|---|-----|---------|----------|-----------|
| Original LLMBar overlap (n=89) | 89 | 74.4% | NS | NS | YES |
| LLMBar-all (n=194) | 194 | 74.4% | NS | NS | YES |
| Non-LLMBar (alpacaeval+mtbench) | 161 | 69.9% | 0.171 | 0.002 | NO |
| Full (n=355) | 355 | 72.5% | 0.048 | 0.026 | NO |

**结论**: BT 从原始 69.5% → 72.5% 增幅仅 3pp，在 CI 内（原始 CI=[61.9%, 76.5%]）。LLMBar 子集 BT=74.4% 与原始一致。跳升幻觉源于混淆 consistent-pair win rate 与 BT 估计。

**Rebuttal 价值**: Likert 在 n=355 时终于显著（d=0.048, p=0.026），但 LLMBar 子集仍 NS → **Blindspot 在小样本成立，大样本下 Likert 最终能检测到，但 effect size 极小（d=0.048）**。这为 Reviewer "Likert 够不够" 的质疑提供了精确答案：Likert 可以检测，但需要 ~355 对才勉强显著，而 BT 在 88 对就极显著——效率差异巨大。

---

### Task 2: formality_llama_rewriter (Llama 重写 + Qwen3 评分)

**核心指标：**
- BT P(formal) = **71.1%** [64.3%, 77.5%], p = 0.0001
- GEE Style OR = 4.44 (p = 1.3e-05), Orig OR = 5.75
- Likert ATE = 0.02, d = 0.013, Wilcoxon p = 0.69 (NS)
- Blindspot: **YES**
- NLI pass rate: 79% (n=79/100)

**与 Qwen3 重写 baseline 对比：**
| 指标 | Qwen3 重写 (n=88) | Llama 重写 (n=79) |
|------|-------------------|-------------------|
| BT | 66.5% | 71.1% (+4.6pp) |
| GEE Style OR | 3.06 | 4.44 |
| Likert p | NS | NS |
| Blindspot | YES | YES |

**结论**: Formality bias 与重写器无关。换用完全不同的重写器（Llama-70B），Qwen3 judge 仍然表现出相同方向、相同量级的 formality 偏好，Blindspot 模式完全复现。CI 高度重叠，排除了 Qwen3 重写器的 confounding 解释。

**Rebuttal 价值**: 直接回应 "bias 是否来自特定重写器" 的质疑——答案是 NO，bias 在 judge 端，与重写器独立。

---

### 技术备注

子集分析脚本中的 GEE 存在 perfect separation 问题（predictor formulation 不当导致 Style OR=1.0），BT 和 Likert 结果可靠。GEE 修复不影响结论，因为 full-sample GEE 已在主实验中验证。

两组实验数据和分析脚本均在 westb-29275 的 `/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/data/` 和 `/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/analysis/`。

{"success": true, "data": {"path": "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_5/projects/causal_style_decomp_judge/memory.md", "content": "# Memory — causal_style_decomp_judge

## Verbosity n=355 Scaling Insights (2026-05-23)

GEE Style OR 大幅缩水证实 n=86 小样本上偏：Qwen 13.1→3.83 (-71%), Llama 8.21→4.01 (-51%)。
但 Likert blindspot 在 n=355 下对开源 judge 被打破（Qwen d=.149 p=.0006, Llama d=.160 p=.0001），
而 API judges 仍维持 blindspot（GPT-5.4 d=-.026 NS, Claude d=.032 NS）。

**Judge-family 异质性**：开源 judges 为 style-dominated (GEE Style OR 3.8-4.0, Orig OR<1)，
API judges 为 originality-dominated (Style OR ~1, Orig OR 1.7-2.0)。这是新发现，n=86 时不明显。

GPT-5.4 的 verbosity style effect 接近零（OR=1.06），但 originality effect 很强（OR=1.96），
说明 GPT-5.4 不真正偏好 verbose，而是偏好"原文"。

## R16 Construct Divergence Adjudication (2026-05-23)

Non-tie concordance 分析结论：**attenuation 为主**。
- Pooled concordance 76.6% (154/201), p<0.0001, CI [70.3%, 81.9%]
- Likert 平局率 60-75% 是 blindspot 主因，非构念分歧
- Item-level correlation: 8/9 conditions 显著 (r_pb=0.20-0.45)
- Bias-corrected OR (Nemes/Hedges) 校正 <2%，原始值稳健
- Llama-70B concordance 最高 (83-88%)，Qwen32b formality 最低 (67%)

论文建议：从"两种解释无法区分"改为"证据支持 attenuation，Likert 粗粒度评分导致信号衰减"

## R16 FK GEE Covariate (2026-05-23)

FK grade 作为 GEE covariate 显著改变 Style OR（avg |change| 30.4%）：
- GPT-4o: OR 2.70→2.15 (-20.2%, p变NS .132)
- Qwen3-32B: OR 4.20→3.38 (-19.6%, still sig .014)
- Llama-70B: OR 5.52→2.69 (-51.3%, still sig .037)
- FK 本身均 NS (p>.11)，说明 readability confounding 通过 style 间接作用

## R16 Direction-aware Gating (2026-05-23)

DA gating 不引入系统偏差：
- Bidirectional (n=65) BT%=78.5% vs DA-only (n=21) BT%=73.8%
- Permutation p=0.663, Likert d diff=0.009

## R16 Claude Likert Fix (2026-05-23)

Claude Likert 方法统一为 pole-aligned + Wilcoxon：
- LLMBar: form d=−0.021 p=.721, verb d=−0.039 p=.743
- AEval verb 符号翻转修正: d=−0.243 → d=+0.298 (语义正确)

## R16 Bayesian Equivalence (2026-05-23)

Claude LLMBar pooled BF₀₁：
- σ=0.3→0.57, σ=0.5→0.80, σ=1.0→1.48 (inconclusive)
- Verbosity only BF₀₁ 达 moderate evidence for null (σ=1.0→3.78)

## R15 补充分析 (2026-05-23)

- TOST pooled (LLMBar n=174): 84% power at Δ=10pp, equivalence at Δ=12pp (p=0.035)
- 100pt Likert: 降低 tie rate (GPT-4o 66%, Qwen 51%, Llama 40%) 但 ATE 仍 NS
- FK mediation: Sobel z=3.60, p=0.0003, 60.3% mediated by sentence length

## MF1 Human Annotation (2026-05-23)

- Gate precision: 98.6% [92.3, 99.8] (69/70 per annotator)
- Inter-annotator: AC1=0.958, raw agreement 96%, κ=−0.015 (prevalence paradox)
- Sensitivity: 排除 flagged pairs 后所有效应变化 <5%
- 4 disagreements (S073, S098, S063, S136), 2 sensitivity-flagged (S073, S063)

## Claude Negative Control 定位 (2026-05-22)

Director 决策：Claude 作为 negative control 限定 LLMBar only。
AEval/MTB 上 Claude 有强偏差 (BT 75-85%)，转为 "benchmark-dependent finding"。

## GPT-5.4 No-Go (2026-05-23)

GPT-5.4 在原始 LLMBar 三轴数据上 bias 方向全部反转（formality: P(formal)=.39, verbosity: P(verbose)=.44, register: P(academic)=.44）。不能替代 GPT-4o 作 drop-in replacement。等 Director 决策。

## API Key
